verses.1: The word of the LORD came to me, saying:
verses.2: You, son of man, thus says the Lord YHWH to the land of Israel: The end has come, the end has arrived on the four corners of the land.
verses.3: The end has come for you. I will pour out my wrath on you, and I will judge you according to your ways, and I will put all your abominations on you.
verses.4: My eyes will not be merciful, and I will not pity you, for I will judge you according to your ways, and your abominations will be among you, and you will know that I am YHWH the striker.
verses.5: Thus says the Lord YHWH: A terrible evil is coming.
verses.6: The end has come, the end has arrived. It is roused against you. It is coming.
verses.7: The dawn is coming to you. The one who dwells on the land has come. The time is near, the day is at hand, and there will be no rest for the mountains.
verses.8: Now I will pour out my wrath on you from near, and complete my anger against you. I will judge you according to your ways, and I will put all your abominations on you.
verses.9: My eyes will not be merciful, and I will not pity you. I will judge you according to your ways, and your abominations will be among you, and you will know that I am YHWH the striker.
verses.10: Look, the day is here, it is coming. The rod is sprouting, the blossom is budding.
verses.11: Violence has risen to the staff of wickedness, not from them, not from the many of them, not from the strong among them, nor was it concealed among them.
verses.12: The time has arrived, the day has come. The one who acquires will not rejoice, and the one who sells will not mourn, for wrath is aimed at all the people of the land.
verses.13: For the one who acquires will not return to the one who sells, and the living among them are still alive, yet vision for all the people of the land will not return, and each one by their sin will live, but they will not be strengthened.
verses.14: Blow the trumpet, prepare everything, for no one is going to war. For my wrath is aimed at all the people of the land.
verses.15: The sword is outside, and plague and famine inside. One who is in the field will die by the sword, and one who is in the city will be eaten by famine and plague.
verses.16: Their fugitives will flee to the mountains like doves of the valleys. All of them will be dead, each one by their sin.
verses.17: Every pair of hands will grow weary, and every pair of thighs will tremble with moisture.
verses.18: They will gird on sackcloth, and humiliation will cover them. On every face there will be shame, and on every head baldness.
verses.19: Their silver will be thrown in the streets, and their gold will be treated as refuse. Their silver and gold will not save them in the day of the wrath of YHWH. Their souls will not be satisfied, and their bellies will not be filled, for their sin has become a snare.
verses.20: The fine things of their glory they have used for pride, and the images of their abominations they made from it. So I have given them to be a disgrace.
verses.21: I will give it to the hands of foreigners for plunder, and to the wicked of the land for spoil, and they will profane it.
verses.22: I will turn my face away from them, and the holy things will be profaned, and intruders will enter it and profane it.
verses.23: Make a sign, for the land is full of bloodshed, and the city is full of violence.
verses.24: I will bring in the leaders of the nations, and they will inherit their houses. I will break the might of the proud, and the holy places of the people will be taken.
verses.25: Panic has come, and they will seek peace, but there will be none.
verses.26: Disaster after disaster will come, and report after report will be heard. They will seek a vision from a prophet, and the teaching will be lost from the priest, and counsel from the elders.
verses.27: The king will mourn, and the official will wear desolation, and the hands of the people of the land will be dismayed. I will do to them according to their ways, and I will judge them by their judgments, and they will know that I am YHWH.

notes:
Notes
- v. 10: The Hebrew "צָץ הַמַּטֶּה פָּרַח הַזָּדֽוֹן" is metaphorical and may refer to a sprouting rod or staff, which I interpreted as "the rod is sprouting, the blossom is budding."
- v. 13: The phrase "לֹא יָשׁוּב וְעוֹד בַּחַיִּים חַיָּתָם" is ambiguous and may refer to people not returning to life or not regaining strength. I translated it as "the living among them are still alive, yet vision for all the people of the land will not return, and each one by their sin will live, but they will not be strengthened."
